policies.combat: No damage, targets, resource changes or cooldowns are calculated by the renderer.

policies.planned: The 16 planned awakening skills are excluded; no implemented server IDs exist.
policies.support: Passive talents and support modifiers do not independently cast.
policies.live: Only explicit authoritative cast/effect descriptors may drive playback. Per-identity and per-mode evidence is tracked in skill-vfx-coverage.json; summaries never create casts.
